articles.summary: A national series at the intersection of women’s sports, media and culture USA TODAY Studio IX, part of USA TODAY Co., Inc. (NYSE: TDAY) alongside Osprey Collective and SEICon today announced the launch of Studio IX Collective, a national, year-round live event and content series designed to create unique opportunities for women and girls, while bringing audiences and brands closer to women’s sports beyond the game. The series combines USA TODAY Studio IX’s national reach and storytelling capabilities, Osprey Collective’s expertise in strategy, programming, talent and community, and SEICon’s global network connecting leaders across sports, entertainment and innovation. Studio IX Collective will create high-energy experiences surrounding major sports tentpoles and cultural moments, connecting athletes, trailblazers, executives, creators, fans and the next generation. articles.title: USA TODAY Studio IX, SEICon and Osprey Collective Launch STUDIO IX Collective - USA TODAY Co.
